conviction_note: The only candidate edge was an arithmetic inference that the FQ1 FY27 guide undershoots a ~$57-58bn consensus: TrendForce says CQ4 conventional DRAM slows to +10-15% (from +13-18%), and Micron's own SCAs cap a quarter to a third or more of revenue at CQ2 prices. The pre-lessons draft sized that at -1.5 with a -1.0 emitted move. It is macro-to-company transmission with no company or counterparty confirmation, it runs against -12 vol points of upside skew, and its sources (a TrendForce release out before today's US open, the 24/7 'guide may look weak' preview) are in the wire. So it is dropped and the name is an honest 0.
bar: FQ4 FY26 revenue: company guide $50.0bn +/- $1.0bn (adj EPS $31 +/- $1, GM ~86%) per the FQ3 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000072312526000013/a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm. Street consensus sits just above the guide: $51.07bn / $31.52 (https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/micron-s-q4-earnings-report-looms-amid-sharp-bull-bear-divide), $50.8bn / $31.5 (https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/micron-q4-earnings-preview-expect-122113904.html), $51.20bn / $31.56 (https://news.alphastreet.com/micron-technology-mu-q4-2026-preview-eps-est-31-56-reports-september-30/). The whisper is higher: UBS $52.4bn / $32.50, Wedbush EPS 'mid-$30s' (https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/micron-berpotensi-naik-harga-memori-melonjak-menurut-wedbush), JPM expects revenue, GM and EPS all above expectations (https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/micron-to-report-q4-earnings-jpmorgan-raises-price-target-to-1-540). outside_window.finding: SK hynix and Samsung 2027 HBM contract pricing lands later: Samsung's Q3 preliminary comes in early October, and TrendForce says 2027 HBM contract prices could be multiples higher, with talks stalled since Q2. That is a read-through to Micron's FY27 HBM economics beyond this print's exit. It only lands tonight if Micron itself announces 2027 HBM pricing, and nothing found says it will.
JPM notes Micron begins returning 100% of excess cash to shareholders from 2026-12-09. The capital-return step-up is dated after the window and was already in sell-side notes.

searched_and_found_nothing: FQ1 guide-shortfall inference. TrendForce CQ4 conventional DRAM is +10-15% against +13-18% for CQ3, and the release says some suppliers lag the average because of LTA terms (https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260930-13258.html, published 2026-09-30 18:08 GMT+8, i.e. before the US open, per https://news.metal.com/newscontent/104142866-ai-server-growth-demand-supports-q4-memory-contract-price-uptrend-consumer-side-pressure-persists). Micron's SCAs carry a ceiling at the CQ2 market price, covering about 25% of revenue (FQ3 call, https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-micron-tops-q3-2026-estimates-shares-jump-131-93CH-4759237); JPM puts it at >35% now. Consensus FQ1 implies about +20% per-week revenue growth over a 14-week FQ4 (Fiscal 2026 is 53 weeks). Dropped as a finding: it is industry-to-company inference, and the 14-week effect and the guide-weak framing are both in the wire (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/29/microns-earnings-guidance-may-look-weak-tomorrow-buy-mu-stock-anyway/).

DRAM spot: TrendForce's weekly updates show DDR5 inquiries slowing and DDR4 2Gx8 correcting in the second half of September (https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/09/16/insights-memory-spot-price-update-dram-spot-cools-as-ddr5-inquiries-slow-2gx8-ddr4-prices-retreat, https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/09/23/insights-memory-spot-price-update-dram-spot-prices-hold-cautious-tone-ddr4-2gx8-drops-3-6/). Spot is a small consumer-channel proxy and does not drive a server-contract-weighted mix, so no finding.

EDGAR since the June print: one 8-K, on 2026-08-26 (items 5.02/9.01). It covers Bhatia's promotion to President/COO, DeBoer to President/CTPO, and Chief Business Officer Sadana moving to Senior Advisor (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000110465926101067/tm2624017d1_8k.htm). This was widely reported and has no sign on the quarter. Form 4 and Form 144 filings July-August look like routine insider sales. No financing filings.
HBM4 at Nvidia: the 'zero share' Semianalysis stories are from February 2026 and were superseded by Micron's March HBM4 volume-production announcement and >$1bn HBM4 revenue in FQ3. Stale.

Counterparty guidance after June 24: Sandisk's FQ1 FY27 guide is +18% sequential against +51% the quarter before (https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/sandisk-reports-fiscal-fourth-quarter-2026-financial-results-2026-08-05). Nanya had record August revenue but only +1.9% month on month (https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20260903PD204/revenue-esmt-2026-nanya-technology-growth.html). Korea's September 1-20 chip exports were a record +259%. All broad, public, and pointing both ways; nothing company-specific and unpriced.
Fab disruptions in Taiwan or Japan in September 2026: none found. The Taichung fire story is from June 2024.
baseline_tension: The price already carries the bull case (+14.8% over 20 days, -12 vol points of upside skew, a whisper above consensus). The only contrary evidence, decelerating CQ4 DRAM contract pricing plus Micron's capped SCAs against an aggressive FQ1 consensus, is an industry-proxy inference that was public before today's session, so nothing found beats the baseline.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company or a counterparty says it): the single draft finding was dropped, taking impact_sum from -1.5 to 0. Its evidence was TrendForce's CQ4 industry forecast and spot data, plus my own arithmetic on the FQ1 consensus. Micron's documents supply only the SCA cap and the 'moderation' language, and both were already known.

Rule 7 (a sign against strong skew needs an explicit reason the options are wrong): I had no company-level reason to overrule -12 vol points of upside skew, which reinforces the drop rather than a smaller negative.

Rule 6 (verify the bar): the FQ4 bar is sourced to the company guide and three agreeing estimate sets. The FQ1 bar has two roughly agreeing sources ($56.85bn, $57.74bn). This left print_vs_bar_pct at +3 unchanged.
The note about pessimism when asking what the market missed: my one draft lean was negative on a name the tape leans positive on. That supports treating the honest zero as the answer.
